description:
“Ah, ah, ah!” 

His heart clenched at the thought that she might open her eyes and scream at any moment. What if Dohwa suddenly woke up, got scared at the sight of her stepbrother, and burst into tears? What if he got his stepsister pregnant while she slept? The thought of seeing her with a swollen belly, becoming his and his alone as she begged him, was also terribly arousing. Chae-eon imagined his stepsister as he took her mercilessly and thrust into her rapidly. 

“I love you, my little one…” 

Chae-eon’s secret pleasure was cherishing his stepsister, whom he had grown up with into adulthood, with tender affection every night.
